subject: science
passage: In a pond, algae and water plants release oxygen into the water during daylight through photosynthesis. At night, photosynthesis stops, but the pond's living things keep using oxygen. Student researcher Amara Osei measured the oxygen in a pond in Ghana every four hours for one day. Her readings show that the oxygen level was lowest ______

data.title: Oxygen Dissolved in a Pond over One Day

stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement?

choices.A: at 4 p.m., when it reached about 10 milligrams per liter.
choices.B: at noon, when the algae were releasing the most oxygen.
choices.C: at 4 a.m., when it was about 4 milligrams per liter.
choices.D: at midnight, when it had dropped to about 5.6 milligrams per liter.

explanation.why: The statement asks when the oxygen level was lowest, so find the lowest point on the line. The line dips to about 4.1 milligrams per liter at 4 a.m., lower than at any other time shown.
explanation.A: Incorrect. At 4 p.m. the oxygen level was at its highest, not its lowest.
explanation.B: Incorrect. At noon the reading was about 8.3 milligrams per liter, well above the lowest value, and the graph does not show when algae released the most oxygen.
explanation.C: Correct. The reading at 4 a.m., about 4 milligrams per liter, is the lowest point on the graph.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The level did drop to about 5.6 at midnight, but it fell even lower, to about 4.1, by 4 a.m.
